name: ambient-life
description: Routine street life — content-driven ambient vignettes (kids, drones, buskers, traffic, crews, vendors, arguments, dogs) that make opted-in city zones feel lived-in, plus two clickable interactions (tip a busker, order from a food cart). Also the private half: home-life routines (including a walk to the ensuite) and a resident's reaction to somebody letting themselves in.
